summary: The school district emphasizes the critical role of E-Rate in providing reliable broadband infrastructure for modern education, highlighting the need to preserve and strengthen the program rather than eliminate or sunset it.

claims.argument: E-Rate provides essential connectivity for schools, preventing disruptions and ensuring educational continuity
claims.evidence_quote: Condon School District 25 J has received $17,280 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $3,456 a year toward the connections our students depend on. That support does not represent a one-time build; it is the recurring cost of keeping a modern network running.
